description: rewind/fork CLI guard compares libgit2 find_remote(url) output (insteadOf rewrites APPLIED, so SSH-proxy form) against canonical run origin; on machines with url.*.insteadOf proxies the comparison can never match, blocking rewind/fork entirely. Workaround: run with empty HOME (no global gitconfig) + remote.origin.url temporarily set to canonical + copied .fabro auth. Fix: read remote.origin.url from raw config (no rewrite) or canonicalize both sides.
